name: Generic pre-authorisation documents
notes: Example rules. Replace with the current NHA HBP mandatory-document list for each package before relying on results.

items.title: Clinical notes detailing history and admission findings
items.description: Notes showing presenting complaints, history, vitals and examination findings that justify admission.

items.title: Investigations done
items.description: Reports of investigations supporting the diagnosis (lab, imaging), with patient name and date.

items.title: Planned line of management
items.description: Treating doctor's plan, including medication or procedure orders.

items.title: Patient photograph at admission
items.description: Photograph of the patient in the hospital bed.

name: Generic claim submission documents
notes: Example rules. Replace with the current NHA HBP mandatory-document list for each package before relying on results.

items.title: Discharge summary
items.description: Signed discharge summary with admission and discharge dates, diagnosis and treatment given.

items.title: Final bill / invoice
items.description: Itemised hospital bill matching the package claimed.

items.title: Treatment records
items.description: Daily progress notes, medication charts or operative notes covering the stay.

items.title: Patient photograph at discharge
items.description: Photograph of the patient at discharge.

name: Himachal Pradesh photo rules
notes: Example state rule set. Confirm wording against the SHA circular.

items.title: Patient photograph taken on the admission day itself (Himachal Pradesh rule)
items.description: Photo must carry a printed date or timestamp matching the admission date.

items.title: A separate patient photograph for each enhancement claimed (Himachal Pradesh rule)
items.description: One photograph cannot evidence two enhancements; each needs its own dated photo.
